integrity: Mathematical derivation uses a complete eight-sector multiplication check; direct finite enumeration is only supporting evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result is for Chein doubles of finite groups and the specified left-valued associator, not arbitrary Moufang loops.
The 2015 identity/associativity-degree specialization and the classical Frobenius character formula are already known.
Historical priority relative to unindexed older loop literature is not conclusively excluded.
title: Seven-sector associator fibers in Chein doubles of finite groups
